version: V8 numerical suffix/context infrastructure; no model candidate
scope: Pure NumPy F64 calculations only; no model/native/file I/O, runtime adapters, or model-quality claim

dimensions.input_containers: Exact NumPy ndarray or ordinary list/tuple; all metadata bounds checked before conversion/finite scan
dimensions.resource_limit: No width-square projector. 4096x17408 F64 guard input is 544MiB; thin SVD output/copies/workspace can exceed 1GiB. Unload model before large dense SVD; this API is bounded, not a low-memory streaming SVD.

suffix.native_inputs: Finite F64 residual, gamma, epsilon, decoded selected head rows, native normalized h and native selected logits from identical fixed prefix
suffix.failure_action: Do not fit if native calibration fails; diagnose instrumentation/formula/kernel correspondence first
suffix.cross_entropy: Use actual corresponding full-vocabulary logZ minus gold logit. Selected-row softmax is not full-model CE; parent logZ cannot be reused after a residual edit changes all logits.

context_key.projection: residual = a_positive - projection onto row span(A); v=residual/dot(a_positive,residual)
context_key.failed_separation_behavior: Return v=null and explicit flag; nonfinite arithmetic rejects input
context_key.interpretation: Protects only supplied guard activations algebraically; neither unseen contexts nor F32 materialization nor changed token trajectories are established.

rank_one_edit_orientation.causal_prerequisite: Native verify final-down input activation a and cached KV are independent of this terminal D edit for an identical token prefix. Do not assume this for earlier layers or different prefixes.

residual_step.target_and_cap: Caller must freeze target pair margin, absolute residual L2 cap, and direction mode before fitting real data
residual_step.default_direction: Analytic pair gradient projected tangent to baseline residual; optional gradient mode is a separate caller-frozen choice
residual_step.search: One fixed normalized improving direction; analytic exact-RMS line peak followed by 64 bisections to smallest target-reaching step on improving branch
residual_step.missed_target: Return best capped direction step with target_reached=false; no global infeasibility or global optimum claim
residual_step.prohibited: No dose sweep, implicit candidate rescaling, restart, or automatic promotion

external_experiment_requirements: Freeze real-data labels, targets, caps, prefix gates and complete-answer rubric before fit; helper constants alone are not a candidate preregistration
Use complete mathematically valid teacher continuations and explicit hard math spans; arbitrary canonical prose is not mathematical truth
Keep actual full-vocabulary sequence CE a soft objective; endpoint and all displayed working decide mathematical validity
Promotion-only direct F32 C must be compared with quantized P before attributing E-C effects to the edit
Materialize direct weights, compute actual F32 E-C norms and activation shifts, and verify all native prefix/control gates after rounding
Algebraic context nullity does not guarantee actual rounded D nullity; stream full supplied early-prefix controls and inspect whole-answer behavior
New evaluation outputs remain excluded from this fit; any later promotion into training must be explicit and replaced with fresh evaluation
No claim of math learning, readiness calibration or generalization follows from synthetic verification or a few solved questions
